title: Answer
description:
The first mountain could be touched, and it could not be approached. Even a beast that touched it died. The mediator of that day was exceedingly afraid.

What has been come to is the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and Jesus the mediator of the new covenant. His blood speaks better things than the blood that cried out.

That city has already been come to, and it is still the city that was waited for.

Do not refuse Him who speaks. He spoke on earth, and He now speaks from heaven. Refusing the voice from heaven is worse than refusing the voice on earth.

Yet once more He will shake not only earth but heaven. What can be shaken will be removed. What cannot be shaken remains.

Our God is a consuming fire. That jealousy is not softened.
